label: Generality versus selectivity
downstream_ambiguity: Two respondents can show similar aggregate support while one extends the disposition across targets and the other withdraws it at a specific social or institutional boundary.
minimum_joint_structure: The same governed proposition applied to at least two distinct governed targets.
incremental_information: Breadth of application and target-selective boundary, including which target class marks the divergence.
v550j_needed_output: Ordered target-role configuration; broad/selective/mixed/insufficient pattern class; target set and boundary location.
v551j_certification_need: Every component must bind to accepted atoms; target identities and response roles must agree; missing target components remain visible.
v552j_use: Provides a bounded structural constraint or context describing target-specific expression rather than an undifferentiated average.
v553_use: Supports comparison only when the family concept and target taxonomy are portable across implementations.
v554_v558_use: May constrain orientation expression and renderer specificity; may not become a stable tolerant/intolerant personality trait.
evidence_ceiling: Observed generality or selectivity across the tested targets and conditions only.
prohibited_claims: Global tolerance trait; motive; future behavior; untested-target generalization.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Commitment versus governed exception
downstream_ambiguity: An apparently general position may hold under ordinary conditions but reverse under explicitly tested exceptions.
minimum_joint_structure: The same proposition or target evaluated under at least two governed conditions.
incremental_information: Whether the position is broad, conditionally bounded, exception-sensitive, or reversed under a named condition.
v550j_needed_output: Condition-role configuration; broad support/opposition; exception pattern; named condition responsible for divergence.
v551j_certification_need: Condition labels, response authority, routing, and required components must be atom-consistent.
v552j_use: Allows pressure interpretation to distinguish a general orientation from a condition-triggered exception.
v553_use: Can become a temporal key only when condition semantics remain stable across waves.
v554_v558_use: Can constrain how an orientation is expressed under pressure; cannot establish motive or a total ideology.
evidence_ceiling: Conditional configuration across the tested conditions.
prohibited_claims: Global ideology; causal trigger; behavior outside tested conditions.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Principle versus concrete application
downstream_ambiguity: Abstract endorsement can conceal withdrawal when the principle is attached to a named institution, group, policy, or case.
minimum_joint_structure: A governed general principle plus one or more governed concrete applications of that principle.
incremental_information: Persistence, narrowing, or reversal from abstract principle to concrete application.
v550j_needed_output: Explicit semantic roles for principle and application; divergence class; application target.
v551j_certification_need: The principle/application relation must be source- or authority-supported, not inferred from a shared driver label.
v552j_use: Provides a narrow constraint on how a disposition is instantiated, useful for distinguishing otherwise similar profiles.
v553_use: Portable only where the abstract and concrete roles are semantically equivalent across instruments.
v554_v558_use: May constrain renderer/application specificity; cannot diagnose hypocrisy, deception, or motive.
evidence_ceiling: Observed alignment or divergence between the tested principle and tested application.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Goal versus means configuration
downstream_ambiguity: Support for an end does not reveal whether the respondent accepts, rejects, or differentiates among the mechanisms proposed to achieve it.
minimum_joint_structure: A governed goal/end item plus one or more governed mechanism/means items tied to the same end.
incremental_information: Means-end alignment, mechanism-specific exception, or unresolved mixed configuration.
v550j_needed_output: Goal role, means roles, mechanism target labels, alignment/divergence class.
v551j_certification_need: Shared goal and mechanism relation must be explicit; components cannot be joined by topic similarity alone.
v552j_use: Constrains likely policy-expression form without collapsing goal support and mechanism approval.
v553_use: Cross-wave use requires stable goal and mechanism semantics.
v554_v558_use: May inform bounded affordances and renderer constraints; cannot label the respondent irrational.
evidence_ceiling: Observed configuration of the tested end and tested mechanisms.
prohibited_claims: Irrationality; incoherence as a person; future action.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Commitment under cost or sacrifice
downstream_ambiguity: An expressed public or moral commitment may or may not survive an explicit personal, distributive, fiscal, risk, or autonomy cost.
minimum_joint_structure: A governed commitment item and a governed cost-bearing application of the same commitment.
incremental_information: Cost-sensitive versus cost-resilient endorsement, limited to the stated cost.
v550j_needed_output: Commitment role, cost role, cost type, persistence/divergence class.
v551j_certification_need: The cost item must be semantically tied to the commitment and not merely a structural-pressure correlate.
v552j_use: Can distinguish a compositional cost boundary from separate material-security conditioning.
v553_use: Comparable only where the cost burden and commitment remain substantively aligned.
v554_v558_use: May constrain willingness expression; cannot predict actual sacrifice or conduct.
evidence_ceiling: Stated commitment under the tested cost framing.
prohibited_claims: Actual future sacrifice; altruism trait; causal effect of income.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Norm versus stated or expected conduct
downstream_ambiguity: Normative approval does not establish whether self-reported, intended, or expected conduct aligns with the norm.
minimum_joint_structure: A governed norm item and a clearly linked governed conduct or expected-conduct item.
incremental_information: Narrow alignment or divergence between stated norm and stated/expected conduct.
v550j_needed_output: Norm role, conduct role, actor scope, alignment/divergence class.
v551j_certification_need: Actor, target, and action domain must match; response semantics must remain distinct.
v552j_use: May provide context or a constraint on expression; often review-sensitive.
v553_use: Portability depends on stable actor and conduct framing.
v554_v558_use: May shape renderer constraints; cannot convert expected or reported conduct into observed behavior.
evidence_ceiling: Alignment between the tested normative judgment and tested stated/expected conduct.
prohibited_claims: Observed behavior; deception; causal motive; moral character.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: General category versus governed subtypes
downstream_ambiguity: A general category judgment can obscure selective endorsement or rejection of governed subtypes within that category.
minimum_joint_structure: A governed general target plus two or more source- or authority-governed subtargets.
incremental_information: Internal differentiation within the category and the location of subtype boundaries.
v550j_needed_output: General target role, subtype roles, taxonomy reference, configuration class.
v551j_certification_need: The general-subtype hierarchy must be authoritative, not assumed from lexical similarity.
v552j_use: Adds structural specificity to a broad orientation.
v553_use: Requires a portable subtype taxonomy or implementation-specific mapping.
v554_v558_use: Can constrain specific expression; cannot generalize to untested subtypes.
evidence_ceiling: Observed differentiation among tested governed subtypes.
prohibited_claims: Complete category attitude; untested subtype inference.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Localization of institutional confidence or legitimacy
downstream_ambiguity: A mean trust score conceals whether confidence or rejection is generalized or concentrated in coercive, political, service, religious, commercial, or supranational institutions.
minimum_joint_structure: Parallel governed judgments across at least two institution classes with a common response topology.
incremental_information: Institution-class profile, concentration, and selectivity without imposing a one-dimensional latent trust scale.
v550j_needed_output: Institution targets and classes; generalized/selective/mixed pattern; unresolved class coverage.
v551j_certification_need: Target classes must be governed and each item must retain its separate atom meaning.
v552j_use: Provides structural-domain localization and possible carrier-channel context.
v553_use: Cross-source comparison requires stable institution-class mappings.
v554_v558_use: May inform carrier mediation requirements and renderer specificity; cannot become a global institutional-trust trait without separate validation.
evidence_ceiling: Observed confidence pattern across the tested institutions.
prohibited_claims: One-dimensional trust trait; institutional knowledge; causal experience.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Reciprocity or symmetric application
downstream_ambiguity: Separate answers may not reveal whether the same standard is applied symmetrically to self/other, in-group/out-group, giver/recipient, or authority/citizen roles.
minimum_joint_structure: Paired or parallel governed items that reverse actor/recipient roles or apply the same rule bidirectionally.
incremental_information: Symmetric application, asymmetric privilege/burden, or unresolved role difference.
v550j_needed_output: Paired role identities, direction of asymmetry, configuration class.
v551j_certification_need: Role reversal must be explicit in source semantics; no moral inference from asymmetry alone.
v552j_use: May supply a bounded relational constraint concerning reciprocity or role-specific application.
v553_use: Portable where role symmetry is genuinely equivalent.
v554_v558_use: May shape relational expression; cannot diagnose selfishness, prejudice, or moral worth.
evidence_ceiling: Observed symmetric or asymmetric application across the tested reciprocal roles.
prohibited_claims: Moral character; motive; general selfishness; general prejudice.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Priority under an explicit tradeoff
downstream_ambiguity: Separate support for two goods does not establish which is prioritized when the instrument explicitly places them in tension.
minimum_joint_structure: Two or more governed goods or ends plus an explicit source-governed tradeoff, forced choice, allocation, or priority relation.
incremental_information: Priority ordering or unresolved balance under the tested tradeoff.
v550j_needed_output: Goods/ends roles, tradeoff frame, priority class, neutrality/indifference state.
v551j_certification_need: The tradeoff must be explicit; independent ratings cannot be converted into a forced priority without authority.
v552j_use: Can become a structural constraint on expression under scarce resources or competing values.
v553_use: Comparable only where the tradeoff framing is stable.
v554_v558_use: May constrain selection among affordances; cannot establish a permanent value hierarchy.
evidence_ceiling: Priority under the tested tradeoff only.
prohibited_claims: Permanent value hierarchy; actual resource allocation; causal scarcity response.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Meaningful internal tension versus ordinary mixture
downstream_ambiguity: Multiple valid atoms can look contradictory, but some mixtures are source-governed conditional configurations while others are unresolved noise or missingness.
minimum_joint_structure: Two or more semantically linked items with an explicit theory of what alignment, reversal, and residual mixture mean.
incremental_information: Governed tension type, conditional configuration, ordinary mixed state, or unresolved state.
v550j_needed_output: Pattern topology; matched boundary rule; residual class; exact components responsible.
v551j_certification_need: All required components and contradiction semantics must be atom-consistent; residual patterns route to review rather than being overnamed.
v552j_use: Can support contradiction/rupture context or a bounded constraint when certified.
v553_use: May support rupture comparison when the same topology recurs across waves.
v554_v558_use: May require mediation or render as bounded tension; cannot become a clinical or ideological diagnosis.
evidence_ceiling: The named tension or mixed configuration within the governed family.
prohibited_claims: Pathology; irrationality; total ideological inconsistency; motive.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Contingent meaning preserved through routing
downstream_ambiguity: A later answer can be uninterpretable or falsely appear missing unless the prior response and routing path are preserved.
minimum_joint_structure: An explicit source-native route linking a gate item to one or more contingent items.
incremental_information: Meaning conditional on applicability and the path that made the item answerable.
v550j_needed_output: Routing path, gate state, contingent item roles, applicability and completeness state.
v551j_certification_need: Non-applicability must never become opposition, neutrality, or ordinary missingness.
v552j_use: Protects structural interpretation from false absence and may supply a narrow contingent constraint.
v553_use: Cross-wave comparison requires stable routing or explicit implementation differences.
v554_v558_use: Preserves known absence and uncertainty; does not authorize unstated beliefs for routed-out respondents.
evidence_ceiling: The contingent configuration for respondents in the governed eligible universe.
prohibited_claims: Inferences about routed-out respondents; imputing unasked answers.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Location of the response boundary
downstream_ambiguity: A selective pattern is more useful when the system knows where support changes, rather than merely that the answers are mixed.
minimum_joint_structure: Ordered or taxonomically related conditions/targets with at least one governed change in response role.
incremental_information: Named target, condition, cost, or threshold at which the configuration changes.
v550j_needed_output: Boundary item/role, before/after response roles, ordering or taxonomy basis.
v551j_certification_need: Order or hierarchy must be explicit; no threshold inference from arbitrary YAML order.
v552j_use: Increases constraint specificity and reduces overgeneralization.
v553_use: Boundary movement may be compared only under stable ordering and concept equivalence.
v554_v558_use: Supports precise renderer constraints; cannot infer a continuous latent threshold unless measured.
evidence_ceiling: Observed boundary among the tested ordered or governed categories.
prohibited_claims: Continuous latent threshold; untested boundary; causal trigger.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Breadth and coverage of a configuration
downstream_ambiguity: A single exception and a broad pattern of exceptions can both look selective at the item level but differ in scope.
minimum_joint_structure: At least three comparable targets or conditions with governed completeness.
incremental_information: Breadth, concentration, and coverage of support/opposition across the tested set.
v550j_needed_output: Eligible set size, answered set, support/oppose/neutral counts by role, breadth class, known absences.
v551j_certification_need: Counts must use only compatible components; neutral, unknown, and inapplicable states remain distinct.
v552j_use: Supports confidence and scope calibration of a constraint or context packet.
v553_use: Breadth classes require comparable set composition or normalized implementation rules.
v554_v558_use: May modulate constraint strength; cannot become a psychometric score by default.
evidence_ceiling: Breadth across the tested governed set.
prohibited_claims: Latent scale score; universe-wide generalization; precision beyond item coverage.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Target-by-condition interaction
downstream_ambiguity: A respondent may apply different conditions to different targets, which cannot be represented by a single target-selectivity or condition-exception summary.
minimum_joint_structure: A source-governed matrix or equivalent set varying both target and condition.
incremental_information: Which conditions alter the position for which targets, including interaction-specific exceptions.
v550j_needed_output: Target and condition roles for each item; interaction cell configuration; residual/insufficient class.
v551j_certification_need: Both dimensions and cell identities must be authoritative; sparse or routed cells remain visible.
v552j_use: Can provide a highly specific structural constraint when coverage and support are adequate.
v553_use: Portability is difficult and requires stable matrix semantics.
v554_v558_use: May support high-specificity renderer constraints; cannot be collapsed into a global orientation.
evidence_ceiling: Observed target-by-condition configuration in the tested matrix.
prohibited_claims: General trait; untested interactions; causal mechanism.
rule: Requirement prioritizes/searches and constrains evidence ceilings; it never by itself creates question membership or respondent relation authority.

label: Complementary-role convergence without latent scaling
downstream_ambiguity: Several differently framed items may jointly corroborate one narrow proposition, while isolated atoms do not indicate whether they converge or pull apart.
minimum_joint_structure: Source- or authority-governed complementary roles addressing the same narrow proposition, not merely multiple indicators with similar wording.
incremental_information: Convergence, role-specific divergence, or insufficient corroboration.
v550j_needed_output: Role set, convergence/divergence class, no default numeric scale.
v551j_certification_need: Each role must contribute a distinct authorized component; support counts cannot substitute for semantic composition.
v552j_use: Potentially increases confidence or routes to review; should rarely create a strong standalone constraint.
v553_use: Only if role structure is stable across implementations.
v554_v558_use: May calibrate confidence, never create a latent trait without a separate validated measurement contract.
evidence_ceiling: Corroboration across the tested complementary roles.
prohibited_claims: Psychometric scale; latent trait; causal explanation.
